title: Chapter 254
text:
No pop-up window, free to read!

Only when he wore Viper would he be the real 'Black Phantom'!

The sudden change caused the troops to fall into a temporary state of chaos. Han Xiao seized this fleeting opportunity and jumped into the car. Hila stepped on the accelerator, and the armored off-road vehicle charged forward like a runaway bull, breaking out of the encirclement.

The Germinal troops still remembered the mission from their superiors and did not dare to delay. They quickly gave chase. Han Xiao had already equipped his long-range weapon and fired at the troops chasing after him.

Most of the vehicles were blown up by him, and there were only a few troops chasing after him. The rest were all left behind.

With a clear path ahead, Hella rushed out of the encirclement. Although she was very tired, she was also excited.

"We escaped!"

Hearing this, Han Xiao had a bad feeling.

As expected, just as he finished speaking, the sound of rotors approached quickly. Three Black Harriers were approaching in a triangle formation.

"This is the Germinal Organization's rapid response force!" Hella's expression changed. "Luckily, there are only three armed helicopters. Their firepower is limited. When they get close, my ability can ignore the armor and directly kill the pilots inside!"

Vroom!

Han Xiao's mechanical suit's built-in radar suddenly sounded an alarm. It detected five individuals with extremely strong life signals on the three helicopters. Comparing them to the database, they were all superhumans above LV 50. They were all the top combat power of the Germinal Organization. These three helicopters were used to transport troops. If they were surrounded by superhumans of the same level, there was no way they could escape successfully. He suddenly felt depressed.

"Are you poisonous? You f * cking shut up. Do you want to die faster?" Han Xiao yelled at Hella. Then, without saying anything, he took off the Ghost sniper rifle from his back, opened it from its folded form, and fired at the pilot seat of the first helicopter.

The bullet with blue electric arcs jumped out of the muzzle and flew across the sky like a thin and straight bolt of lightning!

However, the electromagnetic sniper rifle that had always been successful failed this time!

The bullet with electric arcs suddenly stopped in front of the window of the helicopter. It was as if there was a big hand in the air that grabbed it, and an invisible force field twisted the air.

"A Force Field Ability User, at least Level 55!" Han Xiaoxin's heart sank as he knew that something was wrong.

At this time, a middle-aged woman in a combat suit appeared from a helicopter. Han Xiao zoomed in and saw the woman's appearance clearly. She looked ordinary with a hideous scar that split her lips. Her short hair was fluttering in the wind. She stretched out her hand and aimed at the armored vehicle that had just rushed out of the encirclement.

Han Xiao suddenly felt a strange vibration in the car.

No, it was the ground that was shaking!

The ground within a few dozen meters started to ripple like waves, and a protruding rock slope suddenly appeared in front of them. The armored vehicle couldn't avoid it in time and drove up. The slope became narrower and narrower, and in the end, the entire vehicle shook and was pushed up by the protruding rock slope. It hung in the air more than twenty meters above the ground, and the wheels turned and stopped. The inertia almost caused the two people in the car to fly out.

At the same time, the helicopters flew close to the ground and aimed at the armored vehicles that were unable to dodge and fired a few ship-borne rockets.

Han Xiao and Hella hurriedly abandoned the car and dodged.

Rumble!

The armored vehicles and the rock slope were blown into a burning ball of fire, and the rocks and metal fragments flew everywhere.

Five people jumped down from the helicopters, and they were the five senior executives. They rushed towards the two people. They looked different, but the one thing that they had in common was that they had a very strong aura.

In order to avoid the explosion, the two people just fell to the ground. Hella's eardrums were still hurting. She struggled to get up and looked at the five executives. She gritted her teeth and said, "It's them, the senior executives in the organization, the hidden high-end combat power. The organization won't send them out unless it's an important mission. Five of them appeared at the same time. We are in trouble. Two of them, [Spirit Shield] Jeross controls the force field, [Hand of Earth] Inris controls the soil, and three martial artists, they are …"

"If you have time to talk, you might as well run!"
